raw_response:
I have farmed a long time, and on 18 mu with a wheat-maize system and well irrigation, I will keep my main land in grain and leave a smaller part for cotton. I will put 12 mu into winter wheat, then follow that same 12 mu with summer maize after wheat harvest. I will keep 6 mu for cotton because cotton still gives me cash income, but wheat and maize are the backbone of my farm and fit my usual way of working. Since some family members work off-farm, I will not choose anything too labor-heavy or risky. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps me keep yield stable, rely on well irrigation at key stages, and use moderate fertilizer rather than pushing too hard. For wheat and maize, I will stay with the rotation I know best. For cotton, I will manage inputs carefully because it needs more spraying and more watching through the season. I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for my farm size and saves time compared with deeper ploughing every time.
